from collections import Counter,defaultdict
import numpy as np
coords=[]; cas=[]; chains=Counter(); residues=defaultdict(set); atoms=Counter()
with open('protein.shape.q1.pdb') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')):
            name=line[12:16].strip(); chain=line[21]; res=int(line[22:26])
            x=float(line[30:38]); y=float(line[38:46]); z=float(line[46:54])
            coords.append((x,y,z)); chains[chain]+=1; residues[chain].add(res); atoms[name]+=1
            if name=='CA': cas.append((x,y,z))
arr=np.array(coords); ca=np.array(cas)
print('atoms',arr.shape,'CA',ca.shape)
print('chains',chains)
print('residues', {c:len(s) for c,s in residues.items()})
print('atom names common', atoms.most_common(10))
for name,a in [('all',arr),('ca',ca)]:
    print(name,'min',a.min(axis=0),'max',a.max(axis=0),'range',a.ptp(axis=0),'center',a.mean(axis=0))
    w,v=np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((a-a.mean(0)).T)); idx=np.argsort(w)[::-1]
    print('eig',w[idx], 'ratios', w[idx]/w[idx].sum())
    print('axes',v[:,idx])

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
atoms=[]; ca_by_chain=defaultdict(list); all_by_chain=defaultdict(list)
with open('protein.shape.q1.pdb') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')):
            name=line[12:16].strip(); chain=line[21]
            xyz=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
            atoms.append(xyz); all_by_chain[chain].append(xyz)
            if name=='CA': ca_by_chain[chain].append(xyz)
atoms=np.array(atoms)
# PCA basis
cen=atoms.mean(0); X=atoms-cen
w,V=np.linalg.eigh(np.cov(X.T)); V=V[:,np.argsort(w)[::-1]]
coords={
 'xy': (np.array([1,0,0.]),np.array([0,1,0.])),
 'xz': (np.array([1,0,0.]),np.array([0,0,1.])),
 'yz': (np.array([0,1,0.]),np.array([0,0,1.])),
 'pc12': (V[:,0],V[:,1]),
 'pc13': (V[:,0],V[:,2]),
 'pc23': (V[:,1],V[:,2]),
}
colors=dict(zip(sorted(ca_by_chain),plt.rcParams['axes.prop_cycle'].by_key()['color']))
for name,(u,v) in coords.items():
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,6),dpi=160)
    for ch,pts in sorted(ca_by_chain.items()):
        A=np.array(pts)-cen
        px=A@u; py=A@v
        ax.plot(px,py,lw=1.1,color=colors[ch],label=ch,alpha=.9)
        ax.scatter(px,py,s=3,color=colors[ch],alpha=.4)
    ax.set_aspect('equal','box'); ax.axis('off'); ax.legend(loc='upper right',ncol=6,fontsize=8)
    fig.savefig(f'outputs/proj_{name}_ca.png',bbox_inches='tight',pad_inches=.05)
    plt.close(fig)
    # all atom silhouette
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,6),dpi=160)
    A=atoms-cen; ax.scatter(A@u,A@v,s=.4,c='black',alpha=.20)
    ax.set_aspect('equal','box'); ax.axis('off')
    fig.savefig(f'outputs/proj_{name}_all.png',bbox_inches='tight',pad_inches=.05)
    plt.close(fig)
print('wrote', len(coords)*2, 'images')
PY

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
coords=[]
with open('protein.shape.q1.pdb') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')):
            coords.append([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
A=np.array(coords); cen=A.mean(0); X=A-cen
w,V=np.linalg.eigh(np.cov(X.T)); V=V[:,np.argsort(w)[::-1]]
# coordinates in PCA frame
Y=X@V
x=Y[:,0]; y0=Y[:,1]; z0=Y[:,2]
angles=np.linspace(0,180,18,endpoint=False)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(3,6,figsize=(18,8),dpi=130)
for ax,deg in zip(axs.ravel(),angles):
    th=np.deg2rad(deg)
    y=np.cos(th)*y0+np.sin(th)*z0
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=.12,c='black',alpha=.22)
    ax.set_aspect('equal','box'); ax.axis('off'); ax.set_title(f'{deg:.0f} deg',fontsize=8)
fig.savefig('outputs/long_axis_rotation_all.png',bbox_inches='tight',pad_inches=.05)
plt.close(fig)
print('wrote outputs/long_axis_rotation_all.png')
PY"
